description: Use this when someone asks what stories Sal has along a highway or stretch of road in Washington (e.g. "SR 520 east", "I-90 west from Seattle", or stretch id "sr520-03"). Gives the stories on that stretch in driving order with their durations and total time. Not for navigation, bookings, or roads outside Washington.

dir.description: Optional direction (north, south, east, west) if not in the stretch name

stretch.description: The stretch by road and direction (e.g. "SR 520 east", "I-90 west") or stretch id (e.g. "sr520-03")

name: stretch_stories
title: Stories on a highway stretch
